⭐⭐ TWO SESSIONS, TWO PROJECTS, ONE DAY, THE SAME FOUR FRICTIONS — AND NEITHER SESSION KNEW WHAT THE OTHER WAS HITTING. `hxm_program` reported them as F-02, F-03, F-06 and F-08 in `art:hxm-program-feedback-2026-08-26`; reflow2's own 2026-08-26 session hit all four independently while doing unrelated work. Corroboration across independent users is the evidence class this project has least of, and it arrived by accident.

    FRICTION                              hxm_program              reflow2's own session
    duplicate guard on expected pairs     6 retries (req↔cap)      3 retries (decision↔requirement,
                                                                   brainstorm↔brainstorm)
    revising a Decision resends the       5 whole-field resends    ~8 whole-field resends, one of
    entire field                                                   them ~6,000 characters
    ChangeEvent lands undated unless      9 events, 0 dated        every `detected_at` passed by hand;
    the caller remembers `detected_at`                             the tool's own docs measure the
                                                                   general case at 84% vs 8%
    doing the prescribed thing raises     defects 2 → 7 over a     `unallocated_component` counted 12
    a structural finding                  day of brainstorming     deliberately-parked slices as holes

🛑 THE FOURTH ROW IS ONE DISEASE WEARING TWO FACES, AND IT IS THE IMPORTANT ONE. hxm followed the `brainstorm` skill exactly — ideas as proposed Decisions, linked with CONTRADICTS / ANTICIPATES / DEPENDS_ON and evidence — and `detect_defects` reported the CONTRADICTS as a `contradiction`, the linked ideas as an `unthreaded_cluster`, and each ANTICIPATES as `unresolved_setup`. **Following the instructions made the instrument worse, and `loop_status` then repeated "7 structural defects outstanding" at every check.**

That is precisely the failure reflow2 fixed for ONE detector the same day (`chg:unallocated-component-reads-the-ruling`), whose own rationale recorded the class as still open: *"nothing checks that a NEW structural detector reads the ruling. The next one written will have the same hole for the same reason."* **hxm's F-03 is that prediction arriving as field evidence, from a different project, on the same day it was written down.**

⚠️ AND NOTE WHAT THE `parks` FIX DOES NOT REACH: the tool-surface slices were parked by an ACCEPTED Decision, which is the mechanism. A brainstormed idea has no ruling to point at and should not need one — its `proposed` status IS the statement that it asserts nothing. So the brainstorm case wants either an automatic sweep class for `proposed` Decisions or detectors that skip relation edges on them; the ruling mechanism as built would demand a Decision per brainstorm, which is ceremony the brainstorm skill exists to avoid.

📌 WHAT IS NOT ESTABLISHED: whether these four are the WORST frictions or merely the ones two sessions happened to share. Both sessions were long, graph-heavy and run by the same person's agents; a session that captured little would meet none of them. The corroboration is real and the sample is two.
